a2-08.title: A road trip
a2-08.story: On Saturday, Anna's family went on a road trip to the mountains. Dad took the car out of the [[garage]] early in the morning. Anna and Taras put all their [[stuff]] in the car. Mama packed a small stove and some [[gas]] for cooking. They drove on the [[highway]] for three hours. Taras was tired and in a bad [[mood]]. "Only one more hour, [[max]]," Dad said. In the afternoon, they went [[hiking]] near a beautiful lake. Taras smiled again, and Mama cooked soup on the little stove.

a2-09.title: Planning a holiday
a2-09.story: Anna's parents wanted a summer holiday, but they had a small [[budget]]. They visited a travel [[agent]] in the center of Kyiv. The agent showed them a [[cruise]] to the Greek islands. "You can pay for it on [[credit]]," she said. Dad said no, because they didn't want any money problems. Taras asked, "Can we go to a different [[continent]], like Africa?" "Maybe next year, if we get a [[chance]]," Mama laughed. Finally, they chose a cheap trip to the sea in Bulgaria. Anna was happy, because she wanted to try [[surfing]] there.

a2-10.title: First day at work
a2-10.story: On Monday, Sofia started her new job as a bank [[clerk]]. Her [[boss]], Oleh Bondar, met her at the door. "Your first [[task]] is easy: read these papers," he said. At ten, she went to a short [[training]] about the computer system. A young [[manager]] helped her with her emails. Then Sofia wrote all her meetings in her [[calendar]]. In the afternoon, the bank [[director]] came to say hello. "Work hard, and you can get a [[bonus]]," she smiled. Sofia went home tired but very happy.

a2-11.title: A business meeting
a2-11.story: On Tuesday, Anna's dad had a meeting with a [[businessman]] from Lviv. The man came with his partner, a young [[businesswoman]] named Olena. Their plan was a new city park for one [[million]] dollars. First, everyone had a short [[brainstorm]] about good ideas. Dad said, "A park can have a big [[impact]] on families." Olena agreed: "It's a [[fact]]. Trees have a good [[effect]] on our health." Then they asked an [[expert]] for help with the plan. In the evening, Dad came home in a great mood.

a2-12.title: Problems online
a2-12.story: Anna needed to print her homework for school. But the [[printer]] at home didn't work. Max said, "You need to update the [[software]]." She searched the [[web]] and found the right [[website]]. But first she had to log in to her [[account]]. She forgot her password, so she made a new one. After twenty minutes, everything worked again! Later, Anna wrote a funny [[post]] about it [[online]]. Max liked it first.

a2-13.title: Friday night TV
a2-13.story: On Friday night, Anna and Max watched TV at her house. First, they watched a [[quiz]] with funny questions about animals. Then they started a new [[episode]] of their favorite [[show]]. The [[audio]] was very quiet, so Max turned it up. After that, they chose a [[film]] with a high [[rating]] online. A big [[superstar]] played the main role. At the end, the hero was a robot! It was a real [[shock]] for both of them. Max laughed, "Next Friday, I choose!"

a2-14.title: A music lesson
a2-14.story: On Wednesday, Ira had her first guitar lesson at a music school. Her teacher asked, "What music do you like?" "I love [[rock]], but my brother listens to [[rap]]," Ira said. "The guitar is a good [[instrument]] for both," the teacher said. Then he played a famous [[hip-hop]] [[track]] for her. Ira tried it, but she lost the [[rhythm]] very fast. She said in an angry [[tone]], "I can't do this!" "Don't worry, you have [[talent]]," the teacher answered kindly. At the end of the lesson, Ira played the whole song.

a2-15.title: A big sports weekend
a2-15.story: Last weekend, Max watched a lot of sports on TV. On Saturday, he watched [[golf]], [[cricket]], and [[rugby]]. On Sunday, he watched the big running [[final]]. A young [[runner]] from Ukraine won a gold [[medal]]! "She's a real [[athlete]]," Max said to Sofia. "She trains every day and has a healthy [[lifestyle]]," Sofia answered. "And you sat on the sofa for two days!" Max laughed and turned off the TV. Next weekend, they are going to go [[snowboarding]] in the mountains together.
